pages.title: Topological Boule
pages.text: A boule doped with topological insulator, so its surface conducts and its interior never will. Sliced into wafers, each slice keeps the same protected edges. It is dark grey with a faint metallic sheen around its outside.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Growing a boule from a Lattice Seed Crystal with Topological Insulator and a condensate in the Lattice Growth Vat, I found the protected surface states grew with it, layer by layer.
Made in $(item)Lattice Growth Vat$().$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Topological Matter.$(br2)$(thing)Used in$(): Empirical Notes II, Spacetime Slag, Topological Wafer, Warm Helium.
